hebrewText: כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לִ/מְשִׁיח/וֹ֮ לְ/כ֣וֹרֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱזַ֣קְתִּי בִֽ/ימִינ֗/וֹ לְ/רַד לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וּ/מָתְנֵ֥י מְלָכִ֖ים אֲפַתֵּ֑חַ לִ/פְתֹּ֤חַ לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ דְּלָתַ֔יִם וּ/שְׁעָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִסָּגֵֽרוּ

tokens.bdb: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
tokens.kjv: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah
tokens.kjv: anointed, Messiah.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king
tokens.enLiteralWord: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king
tokens.explanation: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king
tokens.explanationEn: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king

tokens.bdb: Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king
tokens.kjv: Cyrus.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer
tokens.kjv: aid, amend, [idiom] calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of good (take) courage(-ous, -ly), encourage (self), be established, fasten, force, fortify, make hard, harden, help, (lay) hold (fast), lean, maintain, play the man, mend, become (wax) mighty, prevail, be recovered, repair, retain, seize, be (wax) sore, strengthen (self), be stout, be (make, shew, wax) strong(-er), be sure, take (hold), be urgent, behave self valiantly, withstand.

tokens.bdb: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
tokens.kjv: [phrase] left-handed, right (hand, side), south.

tokens.bdb: to tread in pieces, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer, or (specifically) to overlay
tokens.kjv: spend, spread, subdue.

tokens.bdb: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, [idiom] as (long as), at, [phrase] battle, [phrase] because (of), [phrase] beseech, countenance, edge, [phrase] employ, endure, [phrase] enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, [idiom] him(-self), [phrase] honourable, [phrase] impudent, [phrase] in, it, look(-eth) (-s), [idiom] me, [phrase] meet, [idiom] more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), [idiom] on, open, [phrase] out of, over against, the partial, person, [phrase] please, presence, propect, was purposed, by reason of, [phrase] regard, right forth, [phrase] serve, [idiom] shewbread, sight, state, straight, [phrase] street, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them(-selves), through ([phrase] -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward), [phrase] upon, upside ([phrase] down), with(-in, [phrase] -stand), [idiom] ye, [idiom] you.

tokens.bdb: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
tokens.kjv: Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

tokens.bdb: properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins
tokens.kjv: [phrase] greyhound, loins, side.

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.

tokens.bdb: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
tokens.kjv: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

tokens.bdb: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor
tokens.kjv: door (two-leaved), gate, leaf, lid. (Psalm 141:3).

tokens.bdb: an opening, i.e. door or gate
tokens.kjv: city, door, gate, port ([idiom] -er).

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.

tokens.bdb: to shut up; figuratively, to surrender
tokens.kjv: close up, deliver (up), give over (up), inclose, [idiom] pure, repair, shut (in, self, out, up, up together), stop, [idiom] straitly.
